"},{"attributes":{"color":"#000000"},"insert":"These are not ordinary men. They are agents of God's final warning."},{"insert":"

"},{"attributes":{"color":"#000000"},"insert":"I believe I might have found what fills that gap."},{"insert":"

"},{"attributes":{"color":"#000000"},"insert":"The Two Witnesses prophesy for 1,260 days. At the end of that time, the Antichrist kills them. "},{"attributes":{"color":"#000000"},"insert":"• At the end of the 1,290 days: Christ returns — the Second Coming"},{"insert":"

"},{"attributes":{"color":"#000000","bold":true},"insert":"🕐 Three and a Half Days, Three and a Half Years — The Pattern"},{"insert":"

"},{"attributes":{"color":"#000000"},"insert":"One thing I noticed that I want to keep exploring: the Two Witnesses lie dead for 3.5 days, and they minister for 3.5 years. That's not a coincidence. "},{"attributes":{"color":"#000000"},"insert":"I also want to test this number against Gematria at some point. "},{"attributes":{"color":"#000000","bold":true},"insert":"─────────────────────────────────────"},{"insert":"
"},{"attributes":{"color":"#000000","bold":true},"insert":"🕐 What This Module Taught Me"},{"insert":"
"},{"attributes":{"color":"#000000","bold":true},"insert":"─────────────────────────────────────"},{"insert":"

"},{"attributes":{"color":"#000000"},"insert":"Module 3 showed me that the end of the Tribulation isn't a single event — it's a sequence. The Two Witnesses minister. They're killed. They're resurrected. They ascend. The Seventh Trumpet sounds. The Bowls pour out. Then Christ returns."},{"insert":"

"},{"attributes":{"color":"#000000"},"insert":"I believe I'm starting to see the whole picture now. The 7 years of the Tribulation aren't one big blur of judgment. They have a clear structure:"},{"insert":"

"},{"attributes":{"color":"#000000"},"insert":"• Final 30 days: Two Witnesses killed and resurrected, Bowl Judgments poured out"},{"insert":"

"},{"attributes":{"color":"#000000"},"insert":"That's the framework. That's what I'm building in my head. It's still rough, and there are gaps, but I can see the shape of it now."},{"insert":"

"},{"attributes":{"color":"#000000","bold":true},"insert":"─────────────────────────────────────"},{"insert":"
"},{"attributes":{"color":"#000000","bold":true},"insert":"🕐 Deep Dives Flagged from Module 3"},{"insert":"
"},{"attributes":{"color":"#000000","bold":true},"insert":"─────────────────────────────────────"},{"insert":"

"},{"attributes":{"color":"#000000"},"insert":"• The Two Witnesses timeline: how do the 1,260 days and 3.5 days align precisely?"},{"insert":"
"},{"attributes":{"color":"#000000"},"insert":"• The sequence and timing of the Seal, Trumpet, and Bowl judgments"},{"insert":"
"},{"attributes":{"color":"#000000"},"insert":"• The gap between the Two Witnesses' ascension and Christ's return — what fills those final days?"},{"insert":"

"},{"attributes":{"color":"#000000"},"insert":"God doesn't waste time. Every day of those 1,290 days matters. Every judgment has purpose. Today I studied the Gog-Magog War in Ezekiel 38–39 through sections 9.4, 9.5, and 9.6. Here's where I landed:

I'm convinced Gog is Russia. The geographic case is strong — Russia is the farthest nation due north of Israel, and Ezekiel 38:6 and 15 specifically say the invasion comes from "the remote parts of the north." Ukraine is also far north, but Russia has the geopolitical power, nuclear capacity, and historical pattern of aggression that Ukraine doesn't. I'm convinced by the converging lines of evidence: geography, the title "Gog" functioning like Tsar or Pharaoh, ancient genealogy through Japheth in Genesis 10, pre-modern scholarship from 1846 that identified Russia before it was even a superpower, and Voltaire — a hostile witness — reaching the same conclusion 150 years before Russia's rise.
The Russia-Iran coalition makes sense to me now in a way it didn't before. Iran's theology is the engine — the 12th Imam doctrine teaches that destroying Israel hastens the return of their messiah. That's not random geopolitics. It's a religious motivation that combines with Russia's strategic interest in Middle East dominance to create exactly the coalition Ezekiel described. I appreciate Weinberger's 2006 assessment that Putin never genuinely changed from his Soviet roots — twenty years later, that warning has only proven more accurate.
I have a concern about America's focus. We're laser-focused on China as the rising threat, but I believe Russia-Iran alignment in the Middle East is the more immediate prophetic threat. I'm not saying China isn't a player — Revelation 16:12's Kings of the East is real — but I think the Western fixation on China might be a distraction that keeps our eyes off what's actually building in the north.
On the 1982 Lebanon Soviet arms cache and the 1967 Six-Day War nuclear crisis — those weren't Gog-Magog, but they show the historical pattern of Soviet/Russian aggression toward Israel. They reinforce that this isn't a new threat — it's been building for decades.
On Pastor Haney's four power blocs framework (King of the North, King of the South, Kings of the East, Gog-Magog) — I'm holding this loosely. Each individual bloc has scriptural backing, but I haven't found widespread scholarly consensus tying them together as a unified four-bloc system. This is one pastor's interpretive synthesis, and I need to compare it against other scholars before I fully accept the framework.
My core conviction: Gog-Magog is a future, supernatural event happening after the Rapture but before the Tribulation begins. Israel will be living in perceived safety. God will defeat the coalition without Israel firing a shot. The ultimate purpose — Ezekiel 38:23 — is for the nations to know that God is the LORD. As I watch Russia, Iran, and Turkey align in the news, I want to pray for the people of those nations — especially Iran, where millions are reportedly disillusioned with the regime — rather than just watching their governments as actors on a prophetic stage.
"}]}

Today I worked through the Antichrist profile with focus on His Profile section and a deep dive into Daniel 11:37 — "The Desire of Women."

I started by tracking down the Greek word *apoleia* (G684) using e-Sword's right-click Greek search function. This revealed that "son of perdition" in John 17:12 and "son of destruction" in 2 Thessalonians 2:3 both use the same Greek root, even though English translates them differently. Perdition means final, irreversible destruction — the Antichrist is marked for eternal ruin from the beginning, just as Judas was.

I worked through the four kingdoms (Babylon, Medo-Persia, Greece, Rome) and confirmed that Daniel 2:37–38 explicitly identifies Nebuchadnezzar as the head of gold — the first kingdom. From there, the historical progression is clear: each subsequent kingdom conquered the one before it. The Antichrist rises from this revived Roman system.

On Daniel 11:37, I pulled the Hebrew literals using e-Sword: *chemdah* (desire, delight, precious) and *nashiym* (women, plural). Looking at the verse structure, "desire of women" sits sandwiched between two religious rejections — gods of his fathers and any other god — making it clearly part of a list of religious denials, not personal behavior.

I evaluated all four interpretations: Tammuz (fertility deity women worshiped), Messianic Hope (the Messiah women longed to bear), Homosexuality (weakest grammatically and contextually), and my own reading from April 13th — Cold Disregard for Human Longing. The fourth resonates most with me: the Antichrist's total self-exaltation makes him indifferent to what humanity values. He already believes he *is* God, so human longing is irrelevant to him. This detachment is what makes him dangerous — he has no conscience, no pressure point, no human feeling to exploit.

"},{"attributes":{"color":"#000000","bold":true},"insert":"─────────────────────────────────────"},{"insert":"

"},{"attributes":{"color":"#000000"},"insert":"The way I picture it — and I think this is God showing me something — the Antichrist is going to be charismatic. Very good-looking. Smooth. Believable. They'll say, "finally, things are going the way they used to.""},{"insert":"

"},{"attributes":{"color":"#000000"},"insert":"But then the Antichrist will realize the people are worshiping God, not him. And his pride will break through. He'll decide: "I'll lay down the law. "},{"attributes":{"color":"#000000"},"insert":"That's when he puts a statue or a bust or an image of himself in the Holy of Holies. That's the Abomination of Desolation. That's when the last 3.5 years — the Great Tribulation — officially begins."},{"insert":"

"},{"attributes":{"color":"#000000"},"insert":"Second Thessalonians 2:4 confirms this: the man of lawlessness will take his seat in the temple of God, displaying himself as being God. So my vision of a physical image, probably of the Antichrist himself, demanding worship, lines up with Scripture."},{"insert":"

"},{"attributes":{"color":"#000000","bold":true},"insert":"─────────────────────────────────────"},{"insert":"
"},{"attributes":{"color":"#000000","bold":true},"insert":"🕐 Running to the Mountains — It's Not About Escaping God's Wrath"},{"insert":"
"},{"attributes":{"color":"#000000","bold":true},"insert":"─────────────────────────────────────"},{"insert":"

"},{"attributes":{"color":"#000000"},"insert":"I pushed back on the "flee to the mountains" language. You can't hide from God's wrath. If the bowls and trumpets and seals are pouring out globally, running to a mountain doesn't save you from God's judgment."},{"insert":"

"},{"attributes":{"color":"#000000"},"insert":"But that's the right distinction. Fleeing to the mountains isn't about escaping God's wrath. It's about escaping the Antichrist's wrath. Two completely different things. The Antichrist's persecution is local and political — it's centered on Jerusalem and Judea. He's hunting Jews and believers in his sphere of control. Getting away from that immediate danger zone buys time. It's a practical move."},{"insert":"

"},{"attributes":{"color":"#000000"},"insert":"God's wrath, meanwhile, is global and inescapable. You'll experience the bowl judgments wherever you are. But at least you won't be rounded up by the Antichrist's forces for refusing to worship his image. That's the point of fleeing."},{"insert":"

"},{"attributes":{"color":"#000000","bold":true},"insert":"─────────────────────────────────────"},{"insert":"

"},{"attributes":{"color":"#000000","bold":true},"insert":"─────────────────────────────────────"},{"insert":"

"},{"attributes":{"color":"#000000"},"insert":"The way I see the Tribulation unfolding, based on what I've studied:"},{"insert":"

"},{"attributes":{"color":"#000000"},"insert":"• First 3.5 years: Antichrist signs the covenant with Israel. Everything looks hunky-dory. Temple rebuilt, sacrifices resume, there's a false peace. Seal judgments begin."},{"insert":"

"},{"attributes":{"color":"#000000"},"insert":"• Midpoint: Antichrist gets angry at being overlooked. Breaks the covenant. Sets up the Abomination of Desolation. Starts killing Jews and believers. Persecuted survivors flee to the mountains, hiding in their own land, exiled."},{"insert":"

"},{"attributes":{"color":"#000000"},"insert":"• Last 3.5 years: God says "now I'm really mad." The bowl judgments pour out. The worst period in human history. The Antichrist's local persecution and God's global wrath happen simultaneously. Two layers of judgment."},{"insert":"

"},{"attributes":{"color":"#000000"},"insert":"• End: Christ returns. Second Coming. Antichrist destroyed. Israel saved."},{"insert":"

"},{"attributes":{"color":"#000000"},"insert":"That's the structure. That's what I see when I read these texts together."},{"insert":"

"},{"attributes":{"color":"#000000","bold":true},"insert":"─────────────────────────────────────"},{"insert":"

"},{"attributes":{"color":"#000000"},"insert":"• Whether the "two witnesses" ascension is simultaneous with Christ's return, or separated by some number of days."},{"insert":"
